description: This file is a C source file that defines functions, data structures, and logic for managing menus, properties, and dependencies in a configuration system, likely similar to `menuconfig` used in Linux kernel configuration. It handles menu creation, dependency resolution, property management, and display functionalities.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: Struct representing a menu node in the configuration hierarchy.

classes.name: property
classes.description: Struct representing a property or attribute of a menu or symbol.

classes.name: expr
classes.description: Expression nodes used for dependencies and conditions.

classes.name: symbol
classes.description: Represents configuration symbols like options or choices.

classes.name: file
classes.description: Tracks source file information, including name and line number.

methods.description: Logs a warning related to a menu item.

methods.description: Creates and adds a new menu entry.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_add_menu(void)
methods.description: Creates and enters a submenu.

methods.name: void menu_end_menu(void)
methods.description: Closes the current menu and returns to parent.

methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_set_type(int type)
methods.description: Sets the type of the current menu/symbol.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prop(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a property to the current menu or symbol.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prompt(enum prop_type type,char * prompt,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Associates a prompt string with current menu.

methods.name: void menu_add_visibility(struct expr * expr)
methods.description: Sets the visibility expression for current menu.

methods.name: void menu_add_expr(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)

methods.name: void menu_add_symbol(enum prop_type type,struct symbol * sym,struct expr * dep)

methods.name: void menu_finalize(struct menu * parent)

methods.name: bool menu_has_prompt(struct menu * menu)

methods.name: bool menu_is_empty(struct menu * menu)

methods.name: bool menu_is_visible(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Evaluates whether a menu should be visible based on dependencies.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the prompt text of a menu.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_get_parent_menu(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu.

methods.name: bool menu_has_help(struct menu * menu)

methods.name: void menu_get_ext_help(struct menu * menu,struct gstr * help)
